$comment: NEW-8: a message lives in a CONVERSATION (`messages.conversation_id`), never on a session. A session's thread is the messages of its own conversation: the `conversations` row with kind `session` and `sessionId` = that session (one each, `uniq_conversations_session`). Clients sync the `conversations` shape and key every message through it: keyMessagesBySession(messages, conversations) returns the messages whose conversation belongs to a session, each with that `sessionId`, in input order. A message whose conversation is a dm or a channel (`sessionId` null) belongs to no session; a message whose conversation has not synced yet is held back (never guessed); a legacy `sessionId` the row may still carry is ignored, the conversation decides. Readiness: anything waiting on the messages (the title rungs, the thread's first paint) waits on the conversations shape too. Mirrors: TS src/message-conversation.ts, desktop `domain::message_conversation`, iOS ExpCore `MessageConversation.swift`, Android `domain/MessageConversation.kt`.

cases.name: a session conversation keys its messages to that session, in input order
dm and channel messages belong to no session
a message whose conversation has not synced is held back
a legacy sessionId on the row is ignored: the conversation decides
no conversations synced: nothing is keyed
